svg.title: Public names, private addresses
svg.desc: Two lanes. My phone on Tailscale asks Cloudflare DNS for pdf.htknguyen.dev, gets 192.168.1.60, then connects over the tailnet to the tailscale subnet router, the Coolify VM and Stirling-PDF, and the page loads. A stranger on the internet gets the same answer, but 192.168.1.60 is a private address, nothing on the internet routes to it, and no ports are open at home.

g.text: Anyone can look up the name. Only my devices can reach it.
Nothing on the internet routes to it.
